mapper.select: SELECT P.PURCHASE_NO, P.PURCHASE_DATE, P.COMPLETE_DATE, P.IN_DATE, P.IN_STATUS, P.PURCHASE_TITLE, P.MODIFY_DATE , H.CLIENT_NO, H.CLIENT_NAME, H.CLIENT_ADDRESS, H.CLIENT_EMAIL , H.CLIENT_TEL, H.CLIENT_MAN, E.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NAME , I.PURCHASE_ITEM_CNT, I.PURCHASE_ITEM_INCNT, I.PURCHASE_ITEM_COST , PA.PARTS_NO, PA.PARTS_NAME FROM PURCHASE_ORDER P LEFT JOIN CLIENT_HIS H ON P.CLIENT_NO = H.CLIENT_NO AND COALESCE(P.MODIFY_DATE, P.IN_DATE) BETWEEN H.START_DATE AND H.END_DATE LEFT JOIN EMP E ON P.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN PURCHASE_ITEM I ON P.PURCHASE_NO = I.PURCHASE_NO LEFT JOIN PARTS PA ON I.PARTS_NO = PA.PARTS_NO WHERE P.PURCHASE_NO = #{value}
